title: Local finite-free cover of a cokernel-tuple pullback
statement: Let X be a ringed space, F and G sheaves of modules over its structure sheaf, f : F → G with F of finite type, U an open, n a natural number, and g : O_U^n → (cokernel f)|_U. For each x in U there is an open V containing x with V ≤ U, a natural number m, and an epimorphism from O_V^m onto the pullback of the restrictions of g and of the cokernel projection G|_U → (cokernel f)|_U. Both arrows are restricted by SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE hVU), for hVU : V ≤ U. No coherence of G is assumed.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian), proof of (3), local lifts and image generators in the cokernel paragraph; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01BY

proof.text: The cokernel projection is epi. Use local lifting to lift each of the finitely many basis sections defining g on a neighbourhood of x and intersect those neighbourhoods with U. Restrict all lifts to that common neighbourhood. This also works for n = 0, when there are no sections to lift.

The image of f is an epimorphic image of F, hence is finite type. Choose a neighbourhood of x with finitely many image generators, intersect it with the lifting neighbourhood and restrict the generators. Finite type is precisely the local finite-generator condition.

On the resulting V, generate the pullback by the pairs (e_i,s_i), where s_i is the chosen lift of the i-th basis section, together with the pairs (0,t_j) for the image generators. For a section (a,b) of the pullback, subtract the linear combination of the (e_i,s_i) with coefficients a_i. The remainder has first coordinate zero; its second coordinate is annihilated by the cokernel projection, hence locally comes from F. The image generators locally express this remainder. Therefore the finite-free map to the pullback is locally surjective, and hence epi. Enumerate the disjoint union of the finite lists as ULift (Fin m) and return the cover map.

proof_origin.place: Modules, Lemma 01BY, proof of (3), cokernel paragraph. The pullback packages the source construction from image generators and lifts.

lean.statement:
theorem cokernel_tuple_pullback_local_free_cover (X : RingedSpace.{u})
    (F G : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (f : F ⟶ G)
    (hF : F.IsFiniteType) (U : Opens X) (n : ℕ)
    (g : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ⟶
      (cokernel f).over U) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ (V : Opens X) (hVU : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧ ∃ (m : ℕ)
      (p : SheafOfModules.free (R := (moduleRings X).over V)
        (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) ⟶
          pullback ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE hVU)).map g)
            ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X) (homOfLE hVU)).map
              ((cokernel.π f).over U))), Epi p
